record.paper_title: Open problems on structure of positively curved projective varieties
record.original_question: Let (X,g) be a compact Kähler manifold with semi-positive holomorphic sectional curvature. For p in X, let V_flat,p be the subspace of T_X,p consisting of tangent vectors v such that R_g(v,x,y,z̄)=0 for every x,y,z in T_X,p, and define ntf(X,g)=dim X−inf_p dim V_flat,p. If ntf(X,g)=dim X, must H^0(X, Ω_X^q)=0 for every q>0, and must X be projective?

evidence.quote: Here a tangent vector v ∈ TX,p at a point p ∈ X is said to be truly flat if it satisfies that Rg(v, x, y, z̄) = 0 for any x, y, z ∈ TX,p.

Problem 3.3 ([39, Problem 5.1]). — Let (X, g) be a compact Kähler manifold with semi-positive holomorphic sectional curvature. Assume that ntf(X, g) = dim X. • Does it hold that h0(X, ΩqX)=0 for any q > 0? • Is X automatically projective?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $(X,g)$ be a compact Kähler manifold of complex dimension $n$, and let $R_g$ denote its Riemannian (Chern) curvature tensor extended $\mathbb{C}$-linearly to the holomorphic tangent bundle. For a point $p \in X$, call a tangent vector $v \in T_{X,p}$ truly flat at $p$ if
$$R_g(v, x, y, \bar z) = 0 \quad \text{for all } x, y, z \in T_{X,p},$$
and let $V_{\mathrm{flat},p} \subset T_{X,p}$ denote the subspace of all truly flat vectors at $p$. Define
$$\mathrm{ntf}(X,g) := \dim_{\mathbb{C}} X \;-\; \inf_{p \in X} \dim_{\mathbb{C}} V_{\mathrm{flat},p}.$$

Assume that $g$ has semi-positive holomorphic sectional curvature, that is, $R_g(v,\bar v, v, \bar v) \ge 0$ for every $v \in T_X$, and assume furthermore that $\mathrm{ntf}(X,g) = \dim_{\mathbb{C}} X$ (equivalently, there exists a point $p \in X$ at which no nonzero truly flat tangent vector exists).

Prove or disprove:
(a) $H^0(X, \Omega_X^q) = 0$ for every $q > 0$;
(b) $X$ is projective.
artifact.category_tag: Kähler manifolds with semi-positive holomorphic sectional curvature
artifact.status_search_result: The problem is posed as an open problem in recent surveys on positively curved projective varieties, and recent works (e.g., on positivity of tangent sheaves and pseudo-effective holonomy principles for Kähler manifolds with nonnegative holomorphic sectional curvature) discuss partial progress under stronger hypotheses (such as no truly flat tangent vector at some point yielding rational connectedness/projectivity), but the full statement under only the maximality condition $\mathrm{ntf}(X,g)=\dim X$ does not appear to be settled. No source verifying a complete resolution was found.

status_evidence.title: Positivity of tangent sheaves of projective varieties
status_evidence.snippet: Discusses maximal rationally connected fibrations for projective manifolds with semi-positive holomorphic sectional curvature and the role of truly flat tangent vectors.
status_evidence.claim: Related results concern projectivity and rational connectedness under no-truly-flat-vector conditions; the maximal-ntf case is treated only partially.

status_evidence.title: On projective manifolds with semi-positive holomorphic sectional curvature
status_evidence.snippet: Studies projective manifolds with semi-positive holomorphic sectional curvature; introduces concepts related to truly flat tangent vectors.
status_evidence.claim: Establishes partial structural results but does not resolve projectivity for arbitrary compact Kähler manifolds with ntf maximal.
